purpose: Adversarial verification of the L2__009 torch.compile-divergence claim, lens = alternative cause (SDPA backend switch, dtype promotion, TF32/reduced-precision, in-place mutation, genuine miscompile).
note: numerics only, no timings; co-tenant GPU

what_actually_compiles.consequence: projections, both attention matmuls, both softmaxes, topk and the whole 128-expert MoE loop run EAGER; they are not in any compiled graph.

hybrid_isolation_compile_only_named_help.finding: the 3-helper hybrid matches the full torch.compile run to the last decimal, so 100% of the divergence lives in those fragments.

tf32_or_reduced_precision_fp32_matmul.pytorch_warning: TensorFloat32 tensor cores for float32 matrix multiplication available but not enabled

sdpa_backend_switch_or_fuse_attention_re.evidence: 0 hits for scaled_dot_product/flash_attention/efficient_attention in the fresh-cache output_code dump; attention never enters a compiled graph

different_gemm_backend.evidence: no extern_kernels.mm/bmm/addmm in any of the 5 generated files

dtype_promotion_or_demotion.evidence: all fragment placeholders and nodes are f32; no cast nodes in the graph fragments

in_place_mutation_index_add_ordering.evidence: MoE loop is behind the line-187 graph break and runs eager; hybrid isolation accounts for the whole divergence without it

genuine_inductor_miscompile.evidence: see fp64 goldens below; the compiled fragments are as accurate or more accurate than eager

surrogate_test_no_compiler_involved.description: pure-eager reference, only the FIRST rms_norm's mean re-associated as an 8-way chunked sum (mathematically identical)
surrogate_test_no_compiler_involved.finding: reduction re-association alone, with no compiler, reproduces the failure signature

mechanism_B_fma_contraction_NOT_IN_CLAIM.op: apply_rotary_pos_emb, a purely pointwise kernel with no reduction anywhere
mechanism_B_fma_contraction_NOT_IN_CLAIM.generated_triton_source: tmp2 = tmp0 * tmp1 ; tmp20 = tmp18 * tmp19 ; tmp21 = tmp2 + tmp20
mechanism_B_fma_contraction_NOT_IN_CLAIM.finding: compiled is decisively MORE accurate (3.3:1 element win), the signature of one fewer rounding, i.e. LLVM contracting mul+add into v_fma_f32. This op alone fails the workload (mr 0.6163) and contains no reduction.
